KAL KA JAWAB 🧩 Riddle #3 · Part 2/2: 50% gira. Wapas kitna?
Riddle: Wapas $1000 pe aane ke liye kitne % profit chahiye? Aur 90% girne pe?
Jawab: 50% gire to 100% chahiye. 90% gire to 900%.
Loss aur recovery symmetric nahi hote. Isliye risk chhota.
